Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When Shen Nong wants to help sick people, add his inner thought: “我要帮助生病的人。”
2. When describing the faraway place, add one visual detail from the setting: “那儿开着黄色的花，像星星一样。”
3. After he notices the beautiful plant, show his curiosity with a short thought: “这种植物能做药吗？”

ideas.reason: The learner already says that Shen Nong wants to help other people.
This gives a simple, fitting visual detail for the distant place.
This naturally shows Shen Nong wondering whether the plant can be medicine.
